data.summary: Whenever this model fires a ranged attack at the closest enemy unit, that attack gets +1 to its Hit roll if the weapon used is: a Punisher gatling cannon against a target that is neither a MONSTER nor a VEHICLE; a battle cannon against a MONSTER or VEHICLE target; or a quad-lascannon against a target that can FLY.

combat.unresolved: The reading gives one unit the same effect twice, where the rule gives it to two units.
